base: exact P6 PAIR_ABS;12 absolute optical statistics; C1 original pair model
AUX_LAMBDARANK: NOT_RUN_OPTIONAL: constrain auxiliary search to2; existing LambdaRank remains standalone strong control with frozen verified OOF, no new dependency

D1.features: P5 exact12 absolute+same12 relative by substrate; common24 for all PL-only models; IDPL56; ID32

D2.features: P4 exact4channels mean/last/relative-index-slope, 12 absolute or12relative; common REL12 main; IDPL44

historical_reference_precision: P6/P7 frozen predictions remain their original12 significant digits; P8 saves17 digits, never refits reference predictions from test labels
primary_normalization: within-candidate-unit average percentile rank (r-1)/(n-1), singleton0; label-free, ties preserved, constant=>.5 when n>1
raw_normalization: diagnostic only fixed lambda.25 per auxiliary, never selection
outer_folds: unchanged authorD1 foldNo0..4 / originalD2 seven date folds
nested_protocol: For each OUTER TRAIN T, selection split U/V by independent group GKF3. Build fresh GKF3 base/aux OOF on U only to train gate; fit base/aux on U and predict V; no V label in any gate-training OOF source. Select using V metrics over all3 selection folds. Final gate trains on newly crossfit T-only OOF, base/aux fit T and predict outer validation. ALL-development context uses identical procedure for historical evaluation.
gate_feature_scope: D1 substrate / D2 experiment; optical dispersion uses all available optical regions in same unit; score context uses frozen candidate IDs, no label values

gate_model.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit weighted TRAIN OOF meta rows only
gate_model.weights: each independent TRAIN group equal; experiments equal within date, normalized mean1
gate_model.supervision: TRAIN-ONLY cross-fitted gain(fixed rank blend lambda.25)-gain(base)

rule_gate: lambda.25 iff unlabeled base-aux Spearman<=threshold .25/.75, threshold choice only training-internal selection CV; constant predictions have correlation0, singleton disables correction
cap: max changed Top25 members=floor(.25*k); try requested lambda then halve up to16 times, else0; never true PCE; <=.25 for all eligible methods; lambda.5 pressure fixed is ineligible
negative_control: Only gate-training OOF meta features permuted across independent groups by seeded cyclic derangement; unequal experiment counts mapped cyclically from source group rows; targets and date weights unchanged; base/aux optical scores never shuffled. Not eligible final selection.
NOOP_rule: If no eligible candidate exceeds own internal-CV NOOP mean gain by1e-10, choose NOOP. No outer/history feedback. One final endpoint P8_SELECTED; family-selected diagnostics and all frozen candidates are not retrospectively selectable.

tail_metrics.unit: D1 substrate / D2 date after experiment equal averaging

history_policy: all previously inspected; full protocol/selection frozen first, then save unlabeled inference and merge scoring-only labels; replay identical second run
joint_method_development: same preregistered template inspired by both datasets history, but P8 numerical candidate selection is separate per dataset; no shared weights or jointly optimized candidate score

bootstrap.meaning: descriptive DEVELOPMENT_REUSED, never new blind validation

W0_target_integrity: Raw H5 exact hashes unchanged; 12-digit published CSV target comparison tolerates serialization only, full score tolerance1e-8 and Top25 exact IDs remain mandatory
